stories.title: Recovery: empty run
stories.notes: Completes with zero candidate decisions. Sparse feed; empty-feed copy early; completed metrics stay at 0.

stories.title: Recovery: few decisions
stories.notes: Ordinary watch. 2–4 decisions appear by Identify/Synthesize. Mixed scanned/scanning/pending cells.

stories.title: Recovery: dense grid
stories.notes: 32-cell location cap, long wrapping paths, long feed (scan/found/idx/info).

stories.title: Recovery: constrained budget
stories.notes: Mid/late budget.status = constraining (amber banner + Est. Time), then complete under reduced scope.

stories.title: Recovery: failed run
stories.notes: Terminal status: failed with message; spinner off; poll stops.

stories.title: Recovery: idle / empty feed
stories.notes: Frozen. Empty feed copy, no locations, running but idle.

stories.title: Recovery: frozen constrained
stories.notes: Frozen mid-run with amber constraint banner.

stories.title: Recovery: frozen mid-scan (few)
stories.notes: Frozen Identify-stage frame from the few-decisions run.

stories.title: Review: empty queue
stories.notes: Zero candidates; hub/queue empty copy; refresh still works.

stories.title: Review: few candidates
stories.notes: Three candidates, mixed EOCR/confidence, uneven evidence tabs. Happy-path Promote with scope filled.

stories.title: Review: dense queue
stories.notes: 12+ candidates: pagination, search, function/confidence filters, long titles.

stories.title: Review: needs disposition
stories.notes: Boots status: needs_disposition on one id (evidence first).

stories.title: Review: Promote validation errors
stories.notes: Defaults omit scope / still-valid so client Promote errors and the banner show.

stories.title: Review: Reject / Defer / Edit / Split
stories.notes: Small set for conditional textareas and the done view after Promote increments Newly Approved.
